# Legacy 4-1 Drone Code

This directory contains vendored legacy code from the 4-1-drone project.

## Status

⚠️ **Not Integrated**: This code is not yet integrated into the v2 engine.

## Purpose

This legacy codebase has been vendor-imported to facilitate future selective refactoring, validation, and precision hardening efforts.

## Future Work

- Selective refactor of components for integration with v2 engine
- Validation of legacy algorithms and data structures
- Precision hardening and modernization
- Migration to v2 architecture patterns

## Usage

This code is provided as-is for reference and future integration work. Do not depend on this code directly until it has been properly validated and integrated into the v2 engine.
